Hyundai Set to Expand Indian SUV Lineup with Upcoming Bayon Launch

28 Oct 2026, 08:20 AM IST · GlobeWire Daily Auto Desk · Source: news.abplive.com

1 min read

Key takeaways

Image: Somnath Chatterjee · Photo source · Cropped to 16:9; original source image

In this article
  1. New Features and Performance
  2. Tech and Safety Standards

New Features and Performance

Hyundai will launch the Bayon SUV on August 26, slotting it between the Venue and Creta models. Built on the Global K platform, the vehicle features a 1.5-liter naturally aspirated engine paired with either a 6-speed manual or iVT transmission. Notable additions include a "boost mode" for the iVT variant to improve acceleration, alongside steering-mounted paddle shifters and drive modes.

Tech and Safety Standards

Equipped for modern connectivity, the Bayon offers 12.3-inch displays, an AI voice assistant, and a Bose audio system. Safety is a focus, incorporating 35 standard features such as 6 airbags, electronic stability control, and ADAS. The structural design utilizes advanced high-strength steel for enhanced durability. While pricing remains unconfirmed, industry estimates place the starting point near ₹9.5 lakh. Further details can be verified via official updates at https://news.abplive.com/auto/hyundai-bayon-suv-features-get-a-boost-mode-but-what-would-be-the-price-1872979
